Event Description

SEE’s annual Homecoming Comedy Show is back and better than ever! This year’s comedy show will be co-headlined by Sal Vulcano and Josh Johnson. They will take the stage, performing individual sets, on Thursday, October 15th in XFINITY Center at 8:00pm. Doors open at 6:30 pm and close at 8:30pm. Tickets are required for entry; UMD community tickets are $20, registered Alumni Association member tickets along with Terrapin Club member tickets are $40, and general public tickets are $50.
